I’m mainly looking at rental income. What’s the expected price and monthly maintenance? I’d want to compare the costs with actual rental demand nearby.

The maintenance is RM0.18 per sq ft, inclusive of sinking fund. For the 900 sq ft Type A, that works out to RM162 per month.
